messages:
Amira Khan: Hi team  first day! Laptop + dock arrived but the monitor box in the onboarding tracker shows delivered to a neighbor. I don't have the monitor here and when I plug my laptop into the dock the external stays black (dock powers laptop). Who should I ping for a missing delivery and any quick dock checks? :wave:

Logistics Bot: Update for RDW-338210: status=delivered, delivered_to=neighbor (Apt 5B), proof_of_delivery=photo_available, last_scan=2026-05-04 09:12 UTC. Reply with 'CLAIM_MISSING' to open a delivery investigation or 'REROUTE_TO_RECEPTION' to ask Facilities to pick up if available.

Amira Khan: I checked with my neighbor at 5B and they don't have it. Reception also doesn't have a package. CLAIM_MISSING please.

Tara - People Ops: Sorry Amira, we'll help sort this. @Logistics Bot thanks 14e6 Please open a courier claim and let us know ETA. In the meantime, Facilities can drop a spare monitor and a spare dock at your desk. @Luis can you help?

Jon (IT): Welcome! Quick dock checklist: 1) Try a different DP/HDMI cable on the dock. 2) If the monitor has a USB-C alt-mode input, try connecting laptop directly to monitor. 3) In macOS System Settings > Displays, hold Option and click "Detect Displays". If you can run `ioreg -lw0 | grep -i DisplayVendorID` and paste output that helps.

Amira Khan: Tried swapping the DP cable, still nothing. Direct USB-C to monitor not available (monitor is DP only). Ran the ioreg command, output: `| "DisplayVendorID" = 610` (only internal display listed).

Jon (IT): That shows the external isn't enumerating. Likely dock port or cable or damaged monitor. @Luis if you can bring a spare dock + monitor that will let us narrow it down quickly. Also Amira, please open an IT ticket with subject "New hire monitor missing / dock not enumerating" so we capture serials.

Logistics Bot: CLAIM_MISSING received for RDW-338210. Action: courier claim opened, courier contacting driver for POD verification. Expected update: 24-72 hrs. If package is confirmed lost, Logistics will ship a replacement with priority.

Luis (Facilities): I can bring a spare Dell U2720Q and a spare dock to your desk in ~30 mins. If Jon wants to meet, I can wait 10 mins and drop both so you can test.

Jordan (Network): Not network related but FYI sometimes dock firmware prevents proper handshake; if spare dock works we should log model + fw revision so we can track failing units.

Amira Khan: Spare please 160a I'll open the IT ticket now. Ticket #IT-47220 created. Thanks everyone!

Luis (Facilities): At your desk now with spare monitor + dock. Plugged it in, external display comes up immediately. Jon, looks like original dock is flaky.

Jon (IT): Thanks Luis. Amira, keep the spare monitor for now. I'll tag the faulty dock for RMA and update the ticket IT-47220 with the asset tag once you confirm. Logistics will follow up on the missing shipping claim.

Amira Khan: Confirmed the spare works. Appreciate the fast help everyone :tada:
